title: Grilled aubergines

media.caption: Remove the skin and top of the aubergines, cut them into thin slices lengthways.
Cook the aubergine slices on a hot cast iron griddle, turning them several times for even cooking and to prevent burning.
Once cooked, arrange the aubergine slices in a dish with high sides, alternating with the seasonings.
Continue layering the aubergine slices with garlic, mint, oil, vinegar and salt.
Once the layers are complete, crush everything with a fork.
Leave the aubergines to marinate for at least 1 hour.
The finished grilled aubergines, ready to be served.

healthBenefits.title: Rich in Antioxidants
healthBenefits.text: Aubergine skin contains nasunin, an antioxidant that helps protect cells from damage caused by free radicals.

healthBenefits.title: Digestive Support
healthBenefits.text: Mint leaves aid digestion and can help soothe the digestive tract, reducing bloating and discomfort.

healthBenefits.title: Heart-Healthy Fats
healthBenefits.text: Extra virgin olive oil is rich in monounsaturated fats, which support cardiovascular health and reduce inflammation.

healthBenefits.title: Immune Boosting
healthBenefits.text: Garlic contains allicin, a compound known for its antimicrobial and immune-supporting properties.

healthBenefits.title: High in Fibre
healthBenefits.text: Aubergines are a good source of dietary fibre, promoting healthy digestion and gut microbiota balance.

healthBenefits.title: Low Calorie, Nutrient Dense
healthBenefits.text: This dish is low in calories while providing essential vitamins and minerals, making it ideal for a balanced diet.

_ingredientsText:
2 aubergines
• 1 clove of garlic
• 20 mint leaves
• extra virgin olive oil
• white wine vinegar
• salt
_preparationText:
Remove the skin and top of the aubergines, cut them into thin slices lengthways and cook them on a hot cast iron griddle, turning them several times for even cooking and to prevent burning.
Once cooked, arrange the aubergine slices in a dish with high sides, alternating with the seasonings.
Once the layers are complete, crush everything with a fork and leave to marinate for at least 1 hour.
